texts.facts: I.A. No. 14713/17, an application for condonation of delay in filing the present review petition is taken up, considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein.
texts.arguments: The solitary contention raised by learned counsel for the review petitioner is by pointing an error apparent on the face of record with reference to the direction contained in para 20(iii) of the order under review which reads thus: 20. (II) The Union of India is further directed to provide financial assistance to the State Government for establishment of Food Laboratory and upgradation of Food Laboratories in accordance with law dated 20.12.2012 and 09.01.2013, so the existing food laboratories may be accredited by the National Accreditation Board. (III) The Union of India is further directed to make financial assistance available to the State for the establishment of 10 Divisional Food Laboratories. By referring to the above, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this Court fell in error apparent on the face of the record by directing the UOI to make financial assistance available for establishment of 10 Divisional Food Laboratories. It is submitted by learned counsel for the UOI that the above said direction is based on a mere proposal made by the State while seeking financial Union Of India Department Of Fodd And ... vs Sambhagiye Nagrik Upbhokta ... on 18 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110029575/ 1 assistance from the UOI. It is further submitted that neither the Food Safety and Standard Act 2006(the Act of 2006 for brevity) nor the rules framed thereunder provide for establishment of food laboratories at every divisional level.
